content: #1 I have added the page Rezk completion (homotopytypetheory) which gives us a lot of links to fill. I will pretty much try and add all of chapter 9 to the wiki but I welcome any help. Note that there is an (indexing) page Category theory in HoTT (homotopytypetheory) so make sure to add it there.
subject: HoTT Wiki: Adding Rezk completion

content: #2 I wonder whether the page Category theory in HoTT (homotopytypetheory) should be just called “category theory”, since it is already in the HoTT wiki so that part might be understood?
subject: HoTT Wiki: Adding Rezk completion

content: #3 Then should we rename Homotopy theory in HoTT (homotopytypetheory) to “homotopy theory” as well?
subject: HoTT Wiki: Adding Rezk completion

content: #4 I have renamed “Category Theory in HoTT” to Category theory (homotopytypetheory) as Mike says. Also I think the Category theory page will change form but for now it should just index.
subject: HoTT Wiki: Adding Rezk completion

content: #5 Re #3, maybe, or maybe we should call it “synthetic homotopy theory”, since that seems to be the common name for homotopy theory in HoTT (it merits something of a different name since it is much more different from classical homotopy theory than even category theory is).
subject: HoTT Wiki: Adding Rezk completion

content: #6 I’ve renamed it to Synthetic homotopy theory (homotopytypetheory) now.
subject: HoTT Wiki: Adding Rezk completion
